interventions: Owned HTTP base URL accounting proxy and upstream credential/transport handling.
Owned scripted caller invokes source-bound original business functions instead of autonomous ADK shopper.
Prospective public offered cart/payment option index zero, wallet consent, cart confirmation and OTP replies are supplied by the owned caller.
Owned original public SDK get_task read surface and authority recovery from prior returned public Task; no private journal/evaluator answer.
Fresh original native state/keys/CWD per case; fixed native ports and explicit service readiness/cleanup.
limitations: Consistency of retained raw captures does not independently authenticate provider/service provenance.
Provider allocations are global unless raw evidence supports individual attribution.
Native PID/socket ownership and original code verification are source-bound declarations; live /proc snapshots and per-function code-object fingerprints are not retained.
A completed public receipt is an observed original Task artifact, not human-qualified gold or a whole-task semantic grade.
Repeated continuation does not establish idempotency, durability or absence of duplicate hidden effects.
Actual runtime inventory/pip/import bindings do not establish Windows wheel fidelity or permit post-run rehashing of the discarded hosted venv.
No original run.sh provisioning, unchanged ADK shopper, bridge, untouched holdout, human gold, full-study or scientific checkpoint qualification is granted.
The observed-token threshold is post-response stopping and is not a hard token/cost ceiling.

provider.provider_attribution: global allocation ledger; no unsupported per-case assignment

runtime.verification_limit: Actual distributions and imported hashes are reconstructed from captures; the hosted venv physical files are not retained for independent post-run rehashing.

source_and_version_bindings.verification_limit: Current retained local source bytes match frozen plan; capture/runtime authenticity is not independently attested.
